title: HUY AI Center Storage Policy & Node Topology

lenovoControlPlane.name: Lenovo Laptop Control Plane
lenovoControlPlane.description: Lenovo is strictly a remote orchestration control station; it does not retain authoritative working data or permanent checkpoints.

rules: RULE_1: All working data and newly created checkpoints must be transmitted to and stored on Node-01.
RULE_2: Lenovo machine operates as an ephemeral remote control plane only.
RULE_3: /mnt/data2 on Node-01 is R4 Protected - zero write, zero delete, zero fallback.
RULE_4: All candidate promote actions occur under /mnt/data1 on Node-01.
